notes_for_editor: Identity unknown. The record name is the bare word 'lookout'; OSM tags are only man_made=tower and tower:type=observation, with no ownership, height or date. No register, agency or news source found that places a lookout at these coordinates. Two web searches (Norco, Jurupa Hills). A Hundred Peaks search snippet described a 1935 timber lookout on a Riverside County summit with a 'Ranger Lookout' name on a 1940 map, but the cached Hundred Peaks page does not contain that text, so it is not used. The Corona/Prado/Norco/Temescal WWII aircraft-warning towers are the only regional lead found and are not linked. The name needs checking against OSM edit history or a local map, and a human should confirm the site before any story is published.
